description: Source code for mkbrnimg utility, which creates firmware images by concatenating files with headers and footers, based on OpenWrt's wndr3700.c.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses options, opens output file, appends input files, and finalizes the image.

methods.name: parseopts
methods.description: Parses command-line options for output file, magic number, signature, and CRC polynomial.

methods.name: appendfile
methods.description: Reads a file, computes CRC, writes it to output with padding and footer.

methods.name: init_crc32
methods.description: Initializes CRC32 lookup table based on polynomial.

methods.name: crc32buf
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.
